info.name: Railway System - G1 Train, Station & Route
info.description:
Group 1 API tests (Postman Collection v2.1.0).

How to run: start MySQL (database railway_db seeded) and the Spring Boot backend, then run the whole collection with the Collection Runner in the given order. 'Auth setup' must run first because it stores adminToken, passengerToken and operatorToken. Public endpoints are sent without a token on purpose. Variables newStationId, newRouteId, routeStopId, newTrainId, newTrainNo and runId are filled by the test scripts; do not edit them by hand.

exec: // Local date variables (yyyy-MM-dd) used by search / run-generation requests.
function pad(n) { return n < 10 ? '0' + n : String(n); }
function fmt(d) { return d.getFullYear() + '-' + pad(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + pad(d.getDate()); }
function plusDays(n) { var d = new Date(); d.setDate(d.getDate() + n); return fmt(d); }
